about: Test vectors for the corner geometry (packages/editor/src/corner-geometry.ts, decision 0041). Each: a box w x h, radii (top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left) and smoothing (0 to 1); corners: each corner as drawn, [radius, smoothing, extent]; commands: the outline, SVG's M, L, C and Z with absolute coordinates, rounded to 1e-6. Any implementation (the Rust engine of decision 0040 included) must reproduce corners and commands within 1e-6. figma: the outline Figma's plugin API gives for the same box (fillGeometry, read in the parity file on 2026-11-19); every command list is within 0.02 px of it. Vectors with figma null are inputs Figma doesn't take (smoothing past 0..1, negative radii, empty boxes): what this function makes of them.
